command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$HOME/.local/share/omega777-pocket/pkg-3.1.0"
mkdir -p "$ROOT"
if [ ! -f "$ROOT/.installed-v3.1.0" ]; then
  python3 -m pip install --target "$ROOT" --no-deps 'pocket-tts==3.1.0'
  printf 'pocket-tts==3.1.0\n' > "$ROOT/.installed-v3.1.0"
fi
PYTHONPATH="$ROOT${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}" python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util, json
mods=['pocket_tts','torch','numpy','pydantic','sentencepiece','safetensors','typer','fastapi','uvicorn','multipart','scipy','einops','huggingface_hub','requests']
out={}
for m in mods:
 s=importlib.util.find_spec(m); out[m]=None if s is None else s.origin
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
import pocket_tts
print('pocket_tts_import=ok')
PY
printf 'isolated_bytes='; du -sb "$ROOT" | cut -f1
